title: Tidy Drops
description: Leaf Litter and Wildflowers flooding your inventory? Fix it with one slider.
body:
# Tidy Drops

**Leaf Litter and Wildflowers flooding your inventory? Fix it with one slider.**

Since they were added, Leaf Litter and Wildflowers generate *everywhere* in forests and
meadows — and every single one you brush past ends up as an item. Tidy Drops makes them
drop with a configurable chance instead (default **50%**).

## Features

- 🎚️ **One simple setting:** drop chance from 0% to 100%
- 🖱️ **In-game config:** slider via [Mod Menu](https://modrinth.com/mod/modmenu) — no file editing needed
- 📄 **File config too:** `config/tidydrops.json` → `"dropChancePercent": 50`
- ✨ **Silk Touch always drops** — set 0% and these blocks become Silk Touch exclusives
- 🌊 **Every breaking method covered:** by hand, water flow, pistons, explosions — they all
  go through the same loot hook
- 🎲 Each flower/leaf in a multi-segment block is rolled separately (a 4-flower block at 50%
  drops 0–4, ~2 on average)

## Compatibility

- ✅ Sodium, Iris, Lithium, ImmediatelyFast & friends — no rendering or tick hooks, one tiny loot mixin
- ✅ No Fabric API required, no other dependencies
- ✅ Multiplayer: install **server-side only** and it works for everyone; Mod Menu screen is client-side
- ✅ Datapack-friendly: modifies drops *after* the loot table runs, so custom loot tables still work

## FAQ

**Does it change world generation?** No — the blocks still generate; only their item drops change.

**Fortune?** Fortune doesn't affect these blocks in vanilla, and Tidy Drops keeps it that way.

**Where's the config screen?** Mods → Tidy Drops → Configure (requires Mod Menu).
